Title: Fix chat agent page-write approval path validation so approved proposals targeting `Data/Pages/*.md` do not fail with "outside configured maintenance write directories".
Description:
Problem: proposal approval for normal page writes is still coupled to maintenance-agent write roots, so safe `Data/Pages/*.md` proposals can fail at approval time with `outside configured maintenance write directories`.

Desired outcome:
- Safe page proposals targeting approved wiki paths succeed without depending on maintenance write-root coupling.
- Unsafe traversal targets are rejected before they appear as actionable pending writes.

Acceptance criteria:
- A normal page proposal under the intended chat write scope can be approved successfully.
- Traversal-style targets are rejected at proposal time or clearly blocked before they become pending approvals.
- Automated coverage proves safe writes still require approval while unsafe targets never reach disk.

Validation:
- Reproduce the previously failing approval path with a safe page slug.
- Add focused tests around proposal-time path validation and approval-time success for safe slugs.

Audit note: vetted on 2026-05-24; still high-priority. Local audit logs reproduced the failure state and confirmed apply-time safety without fixing operator usability.
